display.purpose: Masthead title and auth-screen headline only; the system's one editorial voice.

label.purpose: Tabs, badges, metadata, timestamps, section headers — anything that is machine-adjacent data rather than human prose. 9.5px is the hard floor; nothing in the system renders smaller.

body.purpose: Inputs, textareas, translation text, comments, glossary notes — anything a human wrote.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system; marks a dropdown menu or modal as floating above the document. Backed by the CSS custom property --shadow-overlay.

motion.name: subtitle-glow
motion.purpose: The masthead subtitle's animated gradient sweep — the system's one ambient 'this is alive' signal, rendered as its own span next to the h1.

motion.name: toast-enter
motion.purpose: Toast notifications slide up and fade in from the bottom-right. Toasts now queue rather than overwrite, so a second message waits its turn instead of clobbering the first.

motion.name: zen-card-transition
motion.purpose: Zen-mode card-to-card transition when navigating between strings.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (save, submit, approve). Fill stays flat on hover by design — full-strength Signal Blue can't host On Accent text at WCAG AA, so interactivity reads through border + glow + lift instead.
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s,transform 0.1s;} .ds-btn-primary{background:#2552c7;border-color:#2552c7;color:#fff2e0;font-weight:500;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset,0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);} .ds-btn-primary:hover{border-color:#4d7cff;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1) inset,0 0 0 3px rgba(77,124,255,0.18),0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);transform:translateY(-1px);} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #4d7cff;outline-offset:2px;} .ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default/secondary button used throughout toolbars and rows.

components.name: Tab Button
components.description: Top navigation tab; mono uppercase label with an accent underline when active.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Small uppercase status pill; color swaps per state (shown here as 'edited'). Uses the micro radius tier (2px) — the smallest corner in the system, reserved for badges, tags, and marks.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard single-line text field used across toolbars and forms.

components.name: Modal Card
components.description: Overlay dialog surface; the one place elevation shadow is used. Announced with role="dialog" aria-modal="true" in the shipped markup.

narrative.overview: This is a quiet, focused control room for overnight and volunteer-shift translation work, not a marketing surface. The palette is a near-black ink-blue lit only by a cold electric-blue accent, so the whole interface reads as a dim console you sit at during a long editing session rather than a page you visit. Precision comes first: a four-tier radius scale (2/3/4/6px, each tied to what it marks) everywhere, dense monospace labels on every badge and tab, and color reserved strictly as a state signal rather than decoration. The one indulgence is an italic serif reserved for a handful of headings and empty-state glyphs — a scholarly, editorial voice breaking through the otherwise technical surface, present exactly where the product is naming itself or an absence, and nowhere else. The system is precise and unshowy by intent: information density and legibility at speed outrank visual flourish.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink-blue surfaces with a single cold-blue accent, used sparingly
Monospace for all labels/tabs/badges/metadata; sans for body copy and inputs; italic serif reserved for display headings only
A four-tier radius scale — 2px micro (badges/tags), 3px control, 4px compact (menu/dropdown rows), 6px card
Color is a state signal (edited / locked / flagged / approved / error), never a mood choice
Flat by default; shadow appears only on floating overlays (menus, modals, dropdowns), carried by one named token, --shadow-overlay

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color allowed to mean 'interactive/focused.' Every other color means a specific translation-workflow state and nothing else.

rules.name: The Dim-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Accent and state colors default to their -dim variant for fills and borders at rest, and jump to full strength only on hover, active, or focus.

rules.name: The On-Accent Contrast Rule
rules.body: On Accent text (#fff2e0) is only safe on -dim fills (accent-dim, err-dim), which clear WCAG AA at 6:1+. It never sits on a full-strength accent fill, which falls to 3.4:1 — those surfaces pair with Void (--bg) text instead.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Spectral italic appears only on headings and empty-state glyphs — never on a button, a badge, or a data row.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Metadata Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono marks labels, states, timestamps, and machine-adjacent data. Human-written prose stays in the sans body font.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Floating Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the normal document flow gets a shadow. Shadow exists solely to mark that an element is floating above everything else, carried by the single --shadow-overlay token.

dos: Do keep every state signal (edited, locked, flagged, approved, mismatch) tied to its one fixed color across the whole app.
Do default accent and state colors to their -dim variant at rest, reserving full-strength color for hover/active/focus.
Do keep the italic Spectral serif confined to headings and empty-state glyphs; everything else is mono or sans.

Do use the four-tier radius scale — 2px micro (badges/tags/marks), 3px control, 4px compact (menu items/dropdown rows), 6px card — and reach for var(--radius-micro)/var(--radius-compact) instead of a new literal.
Do give every interactive element a visible :focus-visible ring (2px solid accent) — it is a system-wide baseline, not opt-in per component.
donts: Don't add a shadow to anything in normal document flow — shadow is reserved to mean 'this is a floating overlay.'
Don't introduce a new accent hue for a one-off feature; extend meaning from the existing state-color vocabulary instead.
Don't put prose a human wrote (comments, translation text, glossary notes) in the monospace font.
Don't round corners past 6px or add soft/large-radius 'friendly' shapes.
Don't put On Accent text on a full-strength accent fill — the pairing fails WCAG AA; pair full-strength fills with Void (--bg) text instead.
